Note.title: Note
Note.description: A user-owned note synchronized across devices in real time. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

remoteUuid.description: Unique identifier of the note matching the Firestore document ID.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the note owner.

content.description: Serialized content blocks of the note.

noteType.description: Type of note (TEXT, CHECKLIST, DRAWING, MATH).

colorIndex.description: Color palette index for the note card.

paperStyle.description: Paper background style (BLANK, RULED, GRID, DOTS).

isTrashed.description: Whether the note is in the trash.

isLocked.description: Whether the note is protected by lock/biometrics.

reminderTimestamp.description: Optional epoch milliseconds for scheduled reminder.

isReminderDone.description: Whether the scheduled reminder has completed.

lastModifiedLocal.description: Client-side epoch milliseconds of last local edit.

remoteUrl.description: Remote storage URL for attached PDF.

remoteImageUrl.description: Remote storage URL for attached main image.

attachmentsJson.description: Serialized JSON array of media attachment metadata.

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: User-isolated subcollection storing synchronized notes for each authenticated user.
